tm.settings.title: Settings
tm.settings.fxUrlHint: Endpoint returning rates.CNY, defaults to Frankfurter
tm.settings.sourcesHint: Price and rate endpoints, click to expand
tm.settings.pricingSourceHint: Each source is a complete catalog: OpenRouter is smallest and carries some tiers plus 1h prices; models.dev has the widest coverage (cross-channel median); LiteLLM has the most 1h prices and long-context tiers.
tm.settings.pricingUrlHint: OpenRouter uses the /models endpoint, models.dev uses api.json, LiteLLM uses model_prices_and_context_window.json
tm.settings.urlTrustHint: Requests include the current session cookie; https public hosts only. Use trusted sites only.
tm.settings.preciseHint: Prices each request separately so long-context tiers apply per request; extra pages are fetched only when needed, and over-budget ranges fall back to aggregate.
tm.settings.cacheTtlHint: The host does not split 5m / 1h cache writes: 5m gives the lower bound, 1h is an explicit assumption (higher amount).
tm.settings.writeFailed: Save failed: local storage is unavailable, changes may revert after restart
tm.settings.invalidUrl: Invalid or untrusted pricing URL (https public host required); fell back to this source's default endpoint
tm.settings.invalidFxUrl: Invalid or untrusted rate URL (https public host required); fell back to the default endpoint
tm.settings.invalidUrls: Both URLs invalid or untrusted (https public hosts required); fell back to default endpoints
tm.settings.resetSettingsHint: Display mode, currency and refresh interval go back to defaults; mappings, catalog cache and custom prices are kept
tm.settings.resetFloatPositionHint: Moves the floating badge back to the top center; other settings are unchanged
tm.settings.dangerHint: These actions apply immediately and cannot be undone. A second click confirms.
tm.settings.confirmDanger: Click "{{action}}" again to confirm, or cancel
tm.settings.pinnedHint: Pinned panels stay open when clicking outside
